title: Hussainiyo bade chalo
body:
hussainiyo bade chalo hayaat ko jhinjhod do
sitam shiyaar jo badhe kalaiyan madod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ka sher aayega to jang bach na payegi
ye keh rahe thay ashkiyan taraai aaj chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ne sagheer se isharon mein ye keh diya
kamaan e zulm cheen lo jo teer aaye tod do
hussainiyo badE chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dil se hurr ne faisla kiya lahoo ki raat ko
hussain hi ka saath do sipah e shaam chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo se dasht e karbala ubhal pade abhi abhi
hussain shukr karke tum jo aag thi nichod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rasool zadiyaan hai ye jo berida hai shaam mein
hussain qatl ho chuke jafayein ab to chod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke boli mayyat e hussain ibne fatema
madad ko phir uthenge hum jo tan ko sar se jod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham e shaheed e karbala mein badh ke salik e hazeen
jo khoon e dil na ro sake un aablon ko phod do
hussainiyo bade chalo...
author: Salik Lakhnavi
